durableFamilies.name: Startup browser state
durableFamilies.technology: SwiftData backed by a SQLite store family
durableFamilies.versionOwner: SumiStartupSchemaV3 3.0.0; recovery manifest format 2 and transition marker format 1 are owned by SumiStartupStoreRecovery
durableFamilies.locationPolicy: <Application Support>/<runtime bundle identifier>/default.store plus SQLite companions; recovery artifacts remain under the sibling StartupPersistenceQuarantine root
durableFamilies.backupRestorePolicy: Backup v1 includes only the startup records represented by SumiBackupV1Scope portable categories: profiles, spaces and themes, folders, essentials, pinned launchers, and regular tabs. History, permission decisions, and extension metadata and payloads remain local. Recovery quarantine separately preserves byte-for-byte SQLite family members before replacement.
durableFamilies.corruptionRecoveryPolicy: Only structured SQLite corruption evidence authorizes quarantine and fresh-store preparation. Schema mismatch, lock failure, migration failure, or unclassified open failure fails closed without destructive replacement. Interrupted filesystem transitions resume from fsynced markers.
durableFamilies.legacySources: No legacy sources; only the current V3 schema is accepted

durableFamilies.name: Bookmarks
durableFamilies.versionOwner: BookmarksModel.xcdatamodeld; BookmarksModel 6 is the only current model
durableFamilies.locationPolicy: <Application Support>/<runtime bundle identifier>/Bookmarks/SumiBookmarks.sqlite plus Core Data SQLite companions
durableFamilies.backupRestorePolicy: Logical backup/import snapshots bookmark entities and uses a bookmark checkpoint for compensation; raw SQLite files are not copied into logical backups
durableFamilies.corruptionRecoveryPolicy: Persistent-store load errors make the database unavailable; the app does not silently delete or recreate a failed bookmark store. Core Data performs inferred lightweight migration where compatible.
durableFamilies.legacySources: No legacy sources; only BookmarksModel 6 is bundled

durableFamilies.name: Preference domain and small session records
durableFamilies.technology: UserDefaults values owned independently by settings, feature, extension, and session types
durableFamilies.versionOwner: There is intentionally no domain-wide schema owner. Each key owner owns its primitive or Codable payload; TabPersistenceCodec owns split archive v2 and WindowSessionSnapshotCodec owns its envelope.
durableFamilies.locationPolicy: The standard preference domain for the runtime bundle identifier; tests use isolated suites. No code may assume a physical plist path.
durableFamilies.backupRestorePolicy: Backup v1 includes no UserDefaults preferences or session settings; those values remain local and are reset by their owning feature.
durableFamilies.corruptionRecoveryPolicy: Primitive keys fall back to owner defaults. Codable owners fail closed to an empty/default snapshot. There is no cross-key transaction.
durableFamilies.legacySources: No legacy migration sources; current owner formats only

durableFamilies.name: Canonical permission activity
durableFamilies.technology: Versioned JSON snapshot with atomic publication and diagnostic unreadable copies
durableFamilies.locationPolicy: <Application Support>/<runtime bundle identifier>/Permissions/permission-state.v1.json; diagnostic copies use the adjacent unreadable suffix
durableFamilies.backupRestorePolicy: Backup v1 excludes permission decisions, activity, and anti-abuse state; all permission persistence remains local operational state.
durableFamilies.corruptionRecoveryPolicy: Unsupported or malformed canonical data fails closed, leaves the original bytes in place, and preserves an adjacent unreadable copy.
durableFamilies.legacySources: No legacy sources; permission-state.v1.json is the only accepted snapshot

durableFamilies.name: Browser and companion credentials
durableFamilies.technology: macOS Keychain generic-password items with separate service/account namespaces
durableFamilies.versionOwner: BasicAuthCredentialStore owns service com.sumi.basicAuth and account prefix v2; BitwardenSafariBiometricHandler and ProtonPassSafariCompanionStore own their independent companion namespaces
durableFamilies.locationPolicy: The login Keychain selected by Security.framework; Sumi does not know or persist a filesystem path
durableFamilies.backupRestorePolicy: Excluded from Sumi logical backup/restore. Keychain/iCloud Keychain policy belongs to macOS and the companion applications.
durableFamilies.corruptionRecoveryPolicy: Unexpected status or undecodable data is treated as unavailable; scoped deletion uses the exact owning service/account query and does not clear unrelated Keychain items.
durableFamilies.legacySources: Basic-auth account identifiers before the v2 prefix may be read only by explicit owner logic; companion schemas are external

durableFamilies.name: Boost definitions and CSS
durableFamilies.technology: Unversioned Codable JSON index plus CSS resource files
durableFamilies.versionOwner: SumiBoostStore.DiskState is the shipped unversioned schema owner
durableFamilies.backupRestorePolicy: Boost import/export is per boost; the global logical browser backup does not promise a raw Boosts directory copy
durableFamilies.corruptionRecoveryPolicy: Malformed JSON loads no boosts, retains the source bytes, and writes an adjacent unreadable diagnostic copy. It is not silently overwritten during load.
durableFamilies.legacySources: The current unversioned shipped DiskState shape

durableFamilies.name: Live folder subscriptions
durableFamilies.backupRestorePolicy: Not currently included in SumiPortableData; restore leaves it local
durableFamilies.corruptionRecoveryPolicy: Read/decode/write/verification failures are surfaced to callers and never interpreted as an empty state. Profile retirement fails closed without overwriting unreadable bytes.
durableFamilies.legacySources: The shipped unversioned SumiLiveFolderDiskState shape; legacy per-source profileId fields are ignored and removed by verified normalization because profile ownership derives from the owning Space

durableFamilies.name: Installed extension packages
durableFamilies.technology: Application Support package directories coordinated with SwiftData ExtensionEntity metadata
durableFamilies.versionOwner: ExtensionPackageInstallTransaction owns staging/publication; ExtensionEntity in SumiStartupSchemaV3 owns installed metadata
durableFamilies.locationPolicy: Extension package roots under <Application Support>/<runtime bundle identifier>; staging and quarantine names are siblings controlled by the package transaction
durableFamilies.backupRestorePolicy: Backup v1 excludes extension metadata, configuration, and package payloads. Installation independently stages package bytes before metadata publication and rolls staged filesystem state back on failure.
durableFamilies.corruptionRecoveryPolicy: Invalid packages are quarantined or removed by explicit maintenance. There is no transaction spanning filesystem, SwiftData, and WebKit activation.
durableFamilies.legacySources: No legacy package layouts; only staged installation generations are supported

durableFamilies.name: Website data by browser profile
durableFamilies.versionOwner: WebKit owns the on-disk schema; Profile owns the stable persistent store identifier and uses nonPersistent() for ephemeral profiles
durableFamilies.locationPolicy: WebKit-selected container locations for the default store and stores identified by profile UUID; Sumi never derives their physical paths
durableFamilies.backupRestorePolicy: Not copied by Sumi logical backup/restore. Browsing-data cleanup uses WebKit APIs per profile.
durableFamilies.corruptionRecoveryPolicy: Delegated to WebKit. Sumi may evict in-memory WKWebsiteDataStore handles or request data removal, but does not edit WebKit database files.
durableFamilies.legacySources: The default WKWebsiteDataStore and existing profile UUID stores

durableFamilies.name: Web extension local storage
durableFamilies.technology: WKWebExtensionController storage owned by WebKit, with app-owned scoped cleanup
durableFamilies.versionOwner: WebKit owns active storage schema; ExtensionRuntimeControllerIdentifierOwner owns controller identifiers
durableFamilies.locationPolicy: WebKit-selected extension storage under the runtime container
durableFamilies.backupRestorePolicy: Not included in logical backup. Extension uninstall/profile cleanup removes only the scoped controller storage and directory.
durableFamilies.corruptionRecoveryPolicy: WebKit handles active store corruption. Scoped cleanup never treats extension package metadata as a database transaction.
durableFamilies.legacySources: No legacy directory adoption; only the resolved current storage identifier is used

durableFamilies.name: Import and restore transaction journal
durableFamilies.technology: Versioned JSON published with POSIX write, fsync, rename, and directory sync
durableFamilies.locationPolicy: <Application Support>/<runtime bundle identifier>/ImportTransaction.json with an adjacent completed tombstone during durable retirement
durableFamilies.backupRestorePolicy: The journal records baseline, target, runtime checkpoint, bookmark checkpoint, and optional pre-restore backup URL; it is recovery metadata rather than user-exported backup content
durableFamilies.corruptionRecoveryPolicy: Malformed or unsupported journal data fails startup recovery closed. Phase transitions are validated and durably published; completed retirement is also fsynced.
durableFamilies.legacySources: Journal v1 is the first shipped format

durableFamilies.name: Logical browser backup archives
durableFamilies.locationPolicy: User-selected export URL, or automatic pre-restore files under <Application Support>/<runtime bundle identifier>/Backups
durableFamilies.backupRestorePolicy: This is the Backup v1 logical boundary defined by SumiBackupV1Scope: profiles, spaces/themes, bookmarks, essentials, pinned launchers, folders, and regular tabs only. Automatic pre-restore backups are created before mutation and retained by policy; imported data is applied through the import journal.
durableFamilies.corruptionRecoveryPolicy: Malformed and unsupported future archives are rejected before mutation. Archive decoding never falls back to current production defaults.
durableFamilies.legacySources: Logical backup v1 is the first shipped archive version

durableFamilies.name: Favicon blob cache
durableFamilies.technology: Blob files plus versioned JSON metadata
durableFamilies.backupRestorePolicy: Excluded from logical backup/restore and safe to rebuild from page/network sources
durableFamilies.corruptionRecoveryPolicy: Metadata decode, unsupported schema, hash, or blob failure invalidates the cache entry/partition; cache bytes are never authoritative browser state
durableFamilies.legacySources: Metadata schema v2 is current; older cache roots are not imported as authoritative data

durableFamilies.name: Generated adblock archives
durableFamilies.technology: Versioned JSON generation manifest plus shard/index files
durableFamilies.backupRestorePolicy: Excluded from logical backup; regenerated from bundled or approved remote rule sources
durableFamilies.corruptionRecoveryPolicy: Manifest version, topology, relative path, size, and SHA-256 validation fail closed. Publication stages a generation before atomic directory/manifest replacement and retention removes only inactive cache generations.
durableFamilies.legacySources: No legacy schemas; the cache is regenerated unless it is schema 6

durableFamilies.name: Approved remote protection bundles
durableFamilies.technology: Signed release JSON, native bundle directories, transactional cache staging, quarantine, and unavailable markers
durableFamilies.versionOwner: SumiProtectionBundleRemoteUpdateConstants release manifest schema 1 and browser expectation 1; native bundle manifest schema 1; signature envelope schema 1
durableFamilies.locationPolicy: <Application Support>/Sumi/AdblockRemoteBundles profile directories with transaction staging and quarantine siblings
durableFamilies.backupRestorePolicy: Excluded from logical backup and re-downloadable from approved signed releases
durableFamilies.corruptionRecoveryPolicy: Signature, pinned key, release schema, downgrade, path, size, and hash checks precede cache publication. Failed commit rolls back; unrecoverable artifacts are quarantined and an unavailable marker prevents false activation.
durableFamilies.legacySources: Native bundle schema 1 and signed release manifest schema 1 are the first shipped formats

durableFamilies.name: Download application choices
durableFamilies.backupRestorePolicy: Not included in logical backup; it is a local OS-application preference
durableFamilies.corruptionRecoveryPolicy: Decode failure falls back to no custom handlers; subsequent explicit user changes replace the file atomically

durableFamilies.name: Compiled WebKit content rule lists
durableFamilies.technology: WKContentRuleListStore compiled artifacts with UserDefaults catalog/status keys
durableFamilies.versionOwner: WebKit owns compiled bytecode; SumiCompiledContentRuleListCatalog owns Sumi's installed identifier catalog
durableFamilies.locationPolicy: WebKit-selected content-rule-list store; Sumi persists only identifiers and status keys in its preference domain
durableFamilies.backupRestorePolicy: Excluded from logical backup and rebuilt from validated adblock generations
durableFamilies.corruptionRecoveryPolicy: Missing or failed compiled lists are removed/recompiled through WebKit APIs; Sumi never edits WebKit bytecode files
durableFamilies.legacySources: Previously compiled WebKit rule-list identifiers tracked by the catalog

crossStoreOperations.compensation: The journal carries runtime and bookmark checkpoints. Failure after either commit enters compensating, restores the committed checkpoint(s), then completes or leaves the durable journal for next-launch recovery.
crossStoreOperations.atomicity: Intentionally not atomic across JSON files, SwiftData, and Core Data. Durable phase ordering and compensation provide recovery, not a distributed transaction.

ordering: Persist owner-specific UI and permission keys
crossStoreOperations.compensation: The package transaction removes or restores staged filesystem state when publication fails; metadata/runtime reconciliation repairs mismatches on later load.
crossStoreOperations.atomicity: No atomic transaction exists across filesystem, SwiftData, UserDefaults, and WebKit. Runtime activation occurs only after package publication.

ordering: Remove WebKit website and extension data through WebKit
crossStoreOperations.compensation: Deletion is idempotent and retries remaining scoped cleanup. Deleted website/cache bytes are not recreated if a later store fails.
crossStoreOperations.atomicity: Intentionally best-effort across OS stores. There is no rollback transaction for privacy deletion.

crossStoreOperations.compensation: Cache transaction rollback restores the previous bundle; generation publication retains the previous active manifest; failed WebKit compilation leaves the old catalog active.
crossStoreOperations.atomicity: No transaction spans filesystem caches, WebKit's rule-list store, and UserDefaults. Activation markers are published last.

ordering: Publish window/session snapshots to their owned preference keys
crossStoreOperations.compensation: Restore planners validate IDs and repair or discard stale session references against the authoritative SwiftData snapshot.
crossStoreOperations.atomicity: No atomic transaction spans SwiftData and UserDefaults; a session snapshot is explicitly a recoverable hint.

ephemeralState.name: Private profile website and extension data
ephemeralState.durableBoundary: Must never be inventoried as a durable WebKit store

ephemeralState.name: In-memory SwiftData test/runtime containers
ephemeralState.durableBoundary: No Application Support path and no migration fixture

ephemeralState.name: Runtime caches and pending UI/session work
ephemeralState.owner: Web view session repositories, favicon memory cache, extension store handle cache, pending debounce tasks, and observable view state
ephemeralState.lifetime: Process, window, profile, or active feature use
ephemeralState.durableBoundary: Only an owning durable type may publish selected state to a family above

ephemeralState.name: Downloads, bookmark HTML exports, Boost exports, and native-host save-panel files
ephemeralState.owner: DownloadDestinationAllocating/SumiDownloadDestinationAllocator reserves names in memory; DownloadFileFinalizing/SumiDownloadFileFinalizer publishes bytes; DownloadOrphanCleaning/SumiDownloadOrphanCleaner removes incomplete .sumiload files; other exporters write through their user-selected URL owners
ephemeralState.durableBoundary: Download reservations are process-ephemeral. Temporary .sumiload files and published downloads are durable user-owned filesystem content, not Sumi-owned stores or migration surfaces
